instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: SubletGate Occupancy Review handles sublet requests containing proposed-occupant and period details, completeness checks, property-condition findings, compliance decisions, occupancy restrictions, and final approval or decline after inspection and compliance inputs. Tenants, Leasing Officers, Property Inspectors, Compliance Reviewers, and Property Managers perform those steps. The supporting-document list, identity-verification role, and decision deadline are undecided. Stakeholders also disagree on whether advertising may begin after the preliminary check or only after final approval, while rent collection and lease renewal are outside the project.

output.summary: SubletGate Occupancy Review handles sublet requests through completeness, property-condition, compliance, and final-decision inputs. Tenants submit proposed-occupant and period details, Leasing Officers check completeness, Property Inspectors record condition findings, Compliance Reviewers record decisions and restrictions, and Property Managers record final outcomes after inspection and compliance inputs. Advertising timing is disputed, while required supporting documents, identity-verification responsibility, and the decision deadline remain undecided. Rent collection and lease renewal are outside the project.
output.primary_goal: Review residential sublet requests using completeness, property-condition, compliance, and final-decision inputs.
key_capabilities: Submit sublet requests with proposed-occupant and period details.
Record compliance decisions and occupancy restrictions.
Record final approval or decline after inspection and compliance inputs.
unresolved_points: Which role verifies the proposed occupant's identity.
The maximum time for issuing the final sublet decision.
Whether advertising may begin before final approval.
